summary: Master systematic incident investigation techniques and root cause analysis. Build investigative expertise that prevents recurrence. Enroll today.
lede: Incident and accident investigation gives workplace safety professionals a structured way to establish what happened and why controls failed. Participants practise preserving and assessing evidence, building event timelines, interviewing witnesses, analysing causal factors and barriers, prioritizing corrective actions, and tracking follow-through in a defensible report.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate workplace incidents, manage safety controls, review operational failures, or approve corrective actions. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with basic hazard, risk, or safety-reporting processes and need a more consistent investigation method.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to workplace safety reporting, hazard controls, operational supervision, or internal auditing. The course uses realistic case evidence rather than requiring access to confidential organizational incidents. No programming experience is needed. Advanced tools such as HFACS, Tripod Beta, AI-assisted pattern review, and Power BI dashboard concepts are introduced at conceptual or operational application level, not production implementation level.
